_instance_comment: State lives in state/carry/btc-hl/ — deliberately distinct from the OKX carry's state/carry/btc/.
_hl_comment: Agent key comes ONLY from env (HL_PRIVATE_KEY or HL_CARRY_PRIVATE_KEY in /etc/trading-bot/carry-hl-btc.env). Sub-account 0x goes in hl_sub_account_address once created; master 0x in hl_account_address (or env HL_CARRY_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS / HL_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS). Any non-DRY mode FAILS CLOSED at startup unless (a) a master/sub account address is set (the agent wallet's own address is never used) AND (b) hl_sub_account_address is set OR hl_dedicated_account_confirmed=true — a carry unwind is a reduce-only market_close on the carry coin, and on an account shared with another lane (e.g. hl-xsectional trades BTC on the master) it would otherwise read/flatten that lane's book.
_mode_comment: PARKED — ships DRY_RUN (trailing-90d +1.98%/yr < +5% green-button). Live needs: dry_run=false AND allow_live=true AND env HL_CONFIRM_LIVE=YES (mainnet) AND per-leg notional <= live_max_usd; okx_demo must stay false (HL has no demo venue — the runner rejects it). Testnet paper = hl_network=testnet + dry_run=false + allow_live=true.
_leverage_comment: L<=2 without top-up automation per HL-CARRY-STUDY; never >4.
_cadence_comment: Hyperliquid funding settles HOURLY: native hourly samples, 24*365=8760 settlements/yr, 90d window = 2160 samples. Do NOT aggregate to 8h. The runner refreshes the window WHOLESALE from funding HISTORY once per settlement (one sample per settled hour) — never per 60s cycle — so 2160 samples really is trailing 90d.
